name: Play interactive text-based choose-your-own-adventure games
description: Users requested to start or continue text-based, choose-your-own-adventure games and interactive stories where the assistant acts as the narrator or game master, presenting options for the user to select. Some requests included specific settings, genres, or detailed mechanics, while a subset focused on explicit or fetishistic content involving bodily functions.
